description: Defines the BuzzPostModel class, which models a social media post and its associated employee data within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It implements serialization and normalization logic to convert BuzzPost entities to API response formats.

classes.name: BuzzPostModel
classes.description: A model class representing a Buzz post for API serialization, wrapping around the BuzzPost entity and exposing selected attributes for API output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BuzzPostModel with a BuzzPost entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
